notes: Hiphil's only attestation (2Kgs.17.21) is a ketiv (וידא) whose qere reads a different root entirely (וַיַּדַּח, H5080 נדח, "he drove away") -- kept per the pipeline's ketiv/qere rule, since the ketiv's own lemma (H5077) differs from the qere's (H5080), making it a genuine textual variant rather than a mere spelling difference. Like H7693 שגל's ketiv-only forms, the ketiv carries no niqqud in the source text (only the qere side, a different word, is vocalized), so heb/translit here are the bare consonants -- not a data-entry gap. Single-attestation and textually contested; flagging per the maintenance guide.

Requested hiphil gloss "drive away; thrust aside" trimmed to "drive away" per the compound-gloss standard: the sole citation (Jeroboam "drove Israel away from following the LORD") shows one action, and "thrust aside" is a synonym for it, not a second sense.
Piel ("postpone", Amos.6.3, "ye that put far away the evil day") is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check.
